entities.name: Unification of Taysir
entities.description: The culmination of a prophecy in which five versions of Taysir, one of each color of mana, merged into one powerful sorcerer on the refracted plane of Rabiah.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A sorcerer of Rabiah who sought out his counterparts and merged with them, igniting his planeswalker spark; he is a planeswalker.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: The Sorceress Queen of Rabiah who seduced the Apprentice Taysir and later banned him from the refracted planes.

entities.name: Black Taysir
entities.description: The black version of Taysir, who absorbed the Green Taysir by force and felt great guilt.

entities.name: Green Taysir
entities.description: The green version of Taysir, absorbed by the Black Taysir.

entities.name: Red Taysir
entities.description: The red version of Taysir, who united willingly with the White Taysir.

entities.name: White Taysir
entities.description: The white version of Taysir, who united willingly with the Red Taysir.

entities.name: Blue Taysir
entities.description: The blue version of Taysir, who later united with the Red and White Taysirs.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: A plane that was refracted into many versions, home of Taysir and Nailah.

events.summary: The Apprentice Taysir, seduced by Nailah, sought out his counterparts across five fractions of Rabiah.
events.quote: Initially seduced by the Sorceress Queen Nailah

events.summary: The Black Taysir absorbed the Green Taysir by force, felt guilt, and turned against Nailah.
events.quote: The Black Taysir absorbed the Green Taysir with force but felt enormous guilt over this and turned against Nailah.

events.summary: The Red and White Taysirs united freely and later united with the Blue Taysir.
events.quote: The Red Taysir and the White Taysir united out of their free will and later united with the Blue Taysir as well.

events.summary: Taysir challenged Nailah and the two halves united into a single Taysir, fulfilling the prophecy and igniting his spark.
events.quote: The white-blue-red Taysir finally united with the green-black one to create a single Taysir, thus fulfilling the prophecy.

events.summary: Taysir left Rabiah never to return; Nailah banned him from the refracted planes.
events.quote: Nailah cast a ban on the refracted planes of Rabiah, locking Taysir out of the 1001 worlds for all time.

relations.note: She banned him from the refracted planes of Rabiah after he challenged her.
